describes: Prose vectors for the deontic plane's producer: plain English sentences and the structured statements (statement.schema.json shape) the language lowers each one to. An empty expected list means the sentence states no norm. The first seven are the credit-decision case; the rest cover the published condition and exception cues and the negative-determiner prohibition. condition-lead-request-of, condition-lead-in-such-a-case and condition-lead-in-the-event-of cover slot_cues.condition_lead_with_phrase ('at the request of', 'in such a case' — the lead's own words are published AS PART OF the condition) and the slot_cues.condition_lead entry 'in the event of' (stripped). 'in the case of' and 'by way of derogation from' are deliberately NOT covered by a positive vector here: neither is a lead this plane consumes (see artifacts/gazetteer/condition.json and exception.json's describes for why) — condition-lead-in-the-case-of-not-consumed and exception-lead-derogation-not-consumed pin that absence instead.

vectors.name: credit-s2-part-of
vectors.sentence: The scoring model is part of the credit system.

vectors.name: credit-s3-prohibition
vectors.sentence: The controller must not make a solely automated decision on a credit application.

expected.action: make a solely automated decision on a credit application

vectors.name: credit-s4-permission
vectors.sentence: The controller may use the score to prepare a decision.

expected.action: use the score to prepare a decision

vectors.name: credit-s5-knowledge
vectors.sentence: The controller knows that the training data is inaccurate.

vectors.name: credit-s6-obligation
vectors.sentence: A reviewer shall examine every rejection before it is sent.

vectors.name: credit-s7-ordering
vectors.sentence: The review follows the automated scoring.

vectors.name: condition-exception
vectors.sentence: If processing is carried out, the controller shall implement appropriate measures unless the processing is occasional.

vectors.name: negative-determiner
vectors.sentence: No processor may engage another processor.

vectors.name: embedded-norm-not-asserted
vectors.sentence: The auditor believes that the processor must delete the data.

vectors.name: condition-lead-in-the-case-of-not-consumed
vectors.sentence: In the case of a data breach, the controller shall notify the authority.

vectors.name: condition-lead-request-of
vectors.sentence: At the request of the data subject, the controller shall provide a copy.

expected.condition: At the request of the data subject

vectors.name: condition-lead-in-such-a-case
vectors.sentence: In such a case, the controller shall notify the authority.

vectors.name: condition-lead-in-the-event-of
vectors.sentence: In the event of a conflict, the controller shall notify the authority.

vectors.name: exception-lead-derogation-not-consumed
vectors.sentence: Member States may, by way of derogation from Article 5, provide for exemptions.

expected.action: by way of derogation from Article 5, provide for exemptions
